main_body: Pink cherry-blossom tree canopy (large rounded blob) on a short brown trunk with a small grass patch at the base
top_band: Organic canopy: lighter pink highlight clumps at the upper part (rows ~2-16) fading to darker magenta at the lower rim; no flat horizontal band, the volume is shaded as a rounded mass
evidence: Organic rounded canopy lit from above with light pink on top and darker magenta underside shading, over a trunk with a ground patch. Reads as a volumetric 3/4 tree, similar to the reference trees; no flat elevation or receding side face. The dark underside of the canopy acts as the eave shadow over the trunk.

style.evidence: The canopy uses about 5 pink/magenta steps with a dark magenta edge that is tinted to the material rather than black, and the trunk has brown shading with a darker green grass base. However, the canopy is built from large smooth blobs of pink with few leaf-clump dots or per-leaf highlights, unlike the reference's busy leaf clusters. Several areas of the canopy and trunk are 5x5+ px of nearly one flat tone, and the tile density is lower than the reference. The result looks softer and more simplified than the Beodeul trees.
